project.name: VieNeu-TTS & DocTruyenApk Integration
project.status: Release v1.6 Deployed (Early G2P Pre-Warming & Native Memory Management)

mobile_app.architecture: MVVM + SingleTop Activities + Bound Foreground Service (ReadingService)

tts_engine.precision: Multi-precision support (User-selectable Dynamic INT8 / FP32 via XNNPACK EP, FP16 via NNAPI EP)
tts_engine.phonemizer: sea-g2p (Rust cross-compiled to Android .so via cargo-ndk) + LRU Phoneme Cache (512 capacity) + Early JNI Warmup
tts_engine.memory_management: Explicit CacheTensor pool recycling, sequential session/options disposal, closed guards, onTrimMemory hook

text_segmentation.features: Linguistic Vietnamese context-aware paragraph/sentence/clause/dialogue parsing (<=75 chars), protected abbreviations, numbers, and time formats

telemetry_diagnostics.features: AI Diagnostic Engine (7 bottleneck flags & actionable recommendations), multi-stage latency breakdown (G2P/Backbone/Codec/Audio), thermal & memory profiling

ci_cd.features: App name slugification, auto-increment minor tag versioning, Keystore base64 decoding & release signing, automated GitHub Releases

features.name: Early G2P Dictionary Pre-Warming & In-Memory LRU Cache
Native Memory Lifecycle Management & Safe Resource Teardown
Model Quantization Pipeline (Dynamic INT8 & FP16 NNAPI)
Dynamic Adaptive Pre-Buffering & Natural Story Cadence

decisions_made.reason: Avoids cold-start dictionary load and regex compilation delays on Chunk 1, reducing G2P time from 129ms to < 5ms.
Recycles intermediate pk/pv tensors across 16 channels in acousticFrame to prevent thousands of un-recycled buffers per sentence.
Releases idle pre-warmed audio cache and G2P dictionary cache when Android triggers TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_LOW/CRITICAL.
Eliminates duplicate activity instances when tapping stories multiple times or returning from notifications.
Saves ~30% RAM (802MB vs 1148MB) and improves RTF to ~0.83-0.90x on mobile devices without perceptible audio degradation.
